title: What are your most effective main agents?
author: New_Patience_8107
selftext:
I try not to overkill with agents but once in a while I notice a big gap in how I'm approaching the project and make one.

My most effective has been my architecture agent. It actually put a structure and philosophy of how my game handles state and data which I didn't realize how much we had been freewheeling and I'm really glad I had it refactor my project early. Honourable mentions to my lead dev and art director who often act as a tag team on pieces to keep work both achievable and keeping to our style brief.

The funniest one I made is a Peter Molyneux agent as the overzealous game director. He comes in, examines the whole project and then suggests outlandish features or development pieces then my lead dev needs to push back on what is feasible. Got some good stuff on the roadmap already from that.

What are your agents like?
